title: Run-Length Encoding of a List (Direct Solution)
required_features: Pinned Synquid algebraic data types and Boolean measures, used by contract.sq to state a recursive exact ordered-expansion relation.
Trusted generic equality primitive eq : 'a -> 'a -> bool, modeled by its equality refinement and mechanically lowered consistently with the OCaml backend's adjacent-equality semantics.
Mechanical lowering from the contract-only RList representation to the exact OCaml 'a rle list result type; RNil maps to [], and RCons maps to list cons.
semantic_obligations: Partition the finite input into maximal nonempty consecutive equality-runs in left-to-right order.
Emit One x exactly for runs of length 1 and Many (n, x) exactly for runs of length n >= 2.
Preserve exact input ordering and multiplicity when output nodes are expanded; do not merge non-adjacent equal values.
Return [] for []; output no zero/negative Many count and no adjacent output nodes for equal values.
Honor the source's directness constraint: do not first construct duplicate sublists.
